name: Jérica (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with a white castle between two yellow ovals bordered red bearing red lions rampant.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 18 May 2007 of the conseller d'Administració Pública, published in the Diari Oficial de la Comunitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, on a field of or four pales of gules and at the centre a castle of argent flanked by two ovals of or bordered red with a lion rampant, with the four pales recalling its status as a royal town, James I having granted its charter in 1249.

features.role: castle masoned and open in black
two ovals bordered red with lions rampant, flanking the castle
